content:
Write and run end-to-end browser-based tests with roc-playwright! This has existed for some time but it seems I never announced it on Zulip :P

Version 0.13.0 was released just now which bumps to the latest Roc and Playwright version (1.64).

This pairs well with roc-spec which lets you run tests in parallel with test environments like web servers, databases, and browsers being setup and torn down.

Have fun! :smile:
